history.rule: materialize.ts swerebench appends step, with @BASE_COMMIT@ replaced by the task's tests/config.json base_commit, to every task's environment/Dockerfile after one blank line; it refuses a step whose sha256 is not step_sha256 and a base_commit that is not 40 hex digits. The step finds the repository the way tests/test.sh does, checks out the base commit detached, removes every remote, ref, tag and stash, ORIG_HEAD, FETCH_HEAD and the other pseudo-refs, expires the reflog, runs git gc --prune=now --aggressive, and fails the build unless HEAD is the base commit, no ref is left and no commit outside the base commit's history is reachable.
